title: 日本ダービーの後に・リフレクト

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide and Winning Ticket suffer defeat at the Japanese Derby, but Winning Ticket refuses to lose heart despite the crushing loss. Her unwavering resolve frightens Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While on the track, visions of a loss-filled future flood Biwa Hayahide's mind, and she can't shake them off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She starts to wonder if the reason Narita Taishin and Winning Ticket keep disrupting her equation is because of their iron will to improve, something which she lacks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Panic fills her at the thought, and she asks me to increase her training intensity so she won't lose at the Kikuka Sho.
